experiment: Experiment 8b — Strategy Escape Isolation: Seeded Diversity vs Stochastic Emergence
pre_registered_hypothesis: Condition 3 (50/50) will survive past Exp 5 collapse tick of 10,039. Survivors will trace predominantly to seeded NAKED lineage, confirming intentional escape is viable.

condition_1.note: Consistent with Exp 5 baseline (10,039). Small variance expected.

condition_3.purpose: Test whether pre-seeded NAKED minority changes outcome

oscillation_phase.ticks_28000_to_50000: Defender drift to near-100%, adapt climbed to 1.50 and held

condition_3.note: Survived full 50K. Founding effect held oscillation for 28K ticks, then defender drift broke it.

key_timeline_condition_3.note: past Exp5 baseline collapse tick, still alive
defender drift begins, NAKED nearly gone
arms race maxed, same trap as Exp 5

pre_registered_hypothesis_check.lineage_verdict: SEEDED_FOUNDING_EFFECT — original agents died by tick 2000 but established 858 NAKED descendants before predator adapted. Founding effect held oscillation for 28K ticks.
pre_registered_hypothesis_check.late_mutation_fate: Late NAKED mutations at ticks 40K-49K failed to establish — arrived into adapt=1.50 hostile environment, confirming founding window hypothesis in reverse.

finding_1.name: Founding population effect confirmed
finding_1.description: Seeded NAKED agents personally died by tick 2000 but reproduced 858 descendants by tick 1000 before the predator adapted at all. That early establishment became structurally load-bearing, suppressing adapt through tick 28000.
finding_1.evidence: seeded_nak_alive: 100 at tick 0, 1 at tick 1000, 0 at tick 2000. NAKED count: 858 at tick 1000.

finding_2.name: Founding window is the pre-adaptation period
finding_2.description: Diversity seeded at tick 0 (adapt=0.00) established and became default before specialization formed. Late mutations appearing at tick 40K-49K (adapt=1.50) arrived into a hostile environment and failed to establish every time. The window is not chronological — it is defined by predator adaptation level.
finding_2.evidence: NAKED count at tick 40K: 12 (died), 43K: 4 (died), 48K: 1 (died). All at adapt=1.50.

finding_3.name: Oscillating equilibrium is a distinct stable state — but fragile to drift
finding_3.description: The founding effect created a new attractor: mixed NAKED/DEFENDER oscillation that held adapt at 0.0-0.4 for 28,000 ticks. But without continuous re-seeding or a floor mechanism to protect NAKED agents under pressure, defender drift eventually swept NAKED to zero, breaking the oscillation and re-entering the Exp5 attractor (adapt=1.50).
finding_3.evidence: Oscillation stable ticks 0-28000. Defender sweep ticks 28000-36000. Adapt 1.50 from tick 36000 onward.
finding_3.constella_relevance: A structural floor that specifically protects low-cost diversity strategies (NAKED-equivalent agents) during drift periods may be what sustains the oscillating equilibrium indefinitely.

constella_implications.pattern_7_earned: Early diversity is founding, late diversity is fragile. The founding window is the pre-adaptation period — before adversarial specialization forms. Diversity introduced at adapt=0.00 becomes structurally load-bearing. Diversity introduced at adapt=1.50 fails to establish.
constella_implications.ucf_and_penumbra_timing: The Penumbra Accord and UCF floor must be designed before a governance crisis, not in response to one. Introduced at maximum stress (adapt=1.50 equivalent), they arrive too late to seed the behavioral diversity they are meant to protect.
constella_implications.drift_problem: Finding 3 is a new design question: even when early diversity establishes successfully, defender drift over long timescales can eliminate it, returning the system to the arms-race attractor. A floor mechanism that specifically protects low-cost diversity strategies during drift may be required to sustain the oscillating equilibrium indefinitely. This is the next experiment question.

lineage_logging_note: Lineage TSV captured 0 events — generation-increment polling hook did not fire because sim.tick() handles reproduction internally without exposing a per-tick increment delta. The population-level seeded_nak_alive column captured the founding effect accurately. Proper lineage logging requires hooking into the reproduction callback in agent.py or simulation.py directly.
